theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_jwc_minor_weak_continuity
theorems.statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (gs : ℕ → Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (g : Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Euclid k) (φ : Euclid k → ℝ), Integrable φ → (∀ j c, LipschitzWith L (gs j c)) → (∀ c, LipschitzWith L (g c)) → (∀ c, TendstoUniformly (fun j => gs j c) (g c) atTop) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, φ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (gs j c) x (V b))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, φ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b))))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
